strings.name: Dylan Field
strings.summary: At Brown, Dylan Field explored web design tools with Evan Wallace, then left after receiving a Thiel Fellowship. He led Figma's browser collaboration, FigJam and design-to-code workflows. Adobe's proposed purchase ended in 2023; Figma later went public independently. In 2026 he continued bringing AI and code into its collaborative canvas.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Figma and developed browser-based collaborative design tools, changing how product design and development teams work together.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: United States; raised in Penngrove, California; exact birthplace unconfirmed

strings.highlights.h1.title: Team design in the browser
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Wallace and the team, he developed real-time tools connecting designers, product managers and engineers.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Independent public company
strings.highlights.h2.text: After regulatory barriers ended Adobe's deal, Figma went public in 2025 and kept expanding design and development products.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Code layers open beta
strings.timeline.t1.text: He announced open testing of code layers, connecting design canvases, coded prototypes and teamwork.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Figma IPO
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company listed on the NYSE; he continued as CEO and chair.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Adobe acquisition abandoned
strings.timeline.t3.text: Both companies saw no route to regulatory approval and terminated the proposed deal, keeping Figma independent.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Adobe acquisition agreement
strings.timeline.t4.text: They announced a roughly $20 billion transaction that ultimately did not close.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Introducing FigJam
strings.timeline.t5.text: The team launched an online whiteboard for brainstorming and early ideas.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Closed beta begins
strings.timeline.t6.text: Figma opened browser-design testing to early users.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Cofounding Figma
strings.timeline.t7.text: He established the company with Evan Wallace and became CEO.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Thiel Fellowship
strings.timeline.t8.text: He received startup support and left Brown to focus on web creative tools.
